3605-4284-4808-5131.description:
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Clone by paying {3}{U}, causing it to enter as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Dance of the Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it triggers, returning Muldrotha from the graveyard to the battlefield tapped with Dance of the Dead attached to it.
Put the copy of Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat.

2317-3967-5478-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving Yahenni indestructible until end of turn
Repeat.

1939-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1939-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Luminous Phantom triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

719-5310-6495-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
719-5310-6495-6879.notes:
If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

997-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
997-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more oil counters on it

1809-1987-3120.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-3120.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-3120.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1116-3240-5670-6772.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-6772.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Syr Vondam and Sek'Kuar trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Syr Vondam and Nether Traitor trigger.
Resolve the Syr Vondam trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7606.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rampant Rejuvenator.
When Rampant Rejuvenator dies, it's innate ability and persist ability each trigger.
Resolve the trigger from Rampant Rejuvenator's innate ability, allowing you to search your library for a number of basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Rampant Rejuvenator from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

6478-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 5 or greater.
6478-7282-7340.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least five mana of any color.
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

789-2292-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-2292-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
789-2292-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

4605-6132-6798-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2557-4050-5086-5183-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2557-4050-5086-5183-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3334-3899-4552.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3334-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1209-4050-4766-7091.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Kozilek, adding {1}.
When Kozilek dies, it, Heirloom Blade and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Kozilek trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Heirloom Blade trigger, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature that shares a card type with Kozilek and put it into your hand
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the creature from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Activate Heirloom Blade's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the creature.
Repeat.
1209-4050-4766-7091.notes: The returned creature may be Kozilek or not. If it isn't, simply ignore the trigger shuffling it into your library, and replace all instances of Kozilek with the returned creature for that iteration.

250-730-779-1479-4693.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-730-779-1479-4693.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

6747-6867-6884.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
6747-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

745-1084-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Mirrorhall Mimic
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1127-1902-3152.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
1127-1902-3152.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Wirewood Channeler.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2486-6798--5.notablePrerequisites:
The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You control your commander.
2486-6798--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to your commander's ability granted to it by Master Chef.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1256-1270-1879-5477.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

116-1486-1753-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
116-1486-1753-4452.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
116-1486-1753-4452.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

2350-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
2350-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2584-3310-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
2584-3310-3490-4659.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Pandemonium triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the creature's power.
War Elemental's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

198-4331-4993.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least one charge counter on it.
198-4331-4993.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

722-2719-3153.notablePrerequisites: Sakashima of a Thousand Faces is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-2719-3153.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

190-1321-4388.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Immortal Coil and causing each opponent to create a token copy of Immortal Coil.
Cast Timetwister by paying {2}{U}, shuffling all graveyards and hands into their owner's library, then causing each player to draw seven cards.
Each opponent's Immortal Coil triggers, causing them to lose the game.

1283-1309-1987-2427.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
